entities.name: Query protein (501 aa)
observations: Sequence length is 501 aa; estimated molecular weight is 52.2 kDa and theoretical pI is 6.67.
Pfam detects YjeF_N (PF03853) at residues 32–193 and Carb_kinase (PF01256) at residues 252–488.
Homologs Q83CM5, P31806, and Q9KMX5 are reviewed bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzymes with 41.5–46.9% identity and 93.4–97.6% query coverage.
Likely catalyzes NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration of (S)-NAD(P)HX; exact substrate scope is inferred from homologs, not experimentally established for this sequence.
Likely binds one K+ ion per subunit based on conserved homolog annotations.
No signal peptide or transmembrane segment is indicated; a soluble intracellular enzyme is the parsimonious localization inference.

entities.name: Bifunctional Nnr
observations: Reviewed bacterial homologs are annotated with EC 5.1.99.6 for NAD(P)HX epimerase activity and EC 4.2.1.136 for ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydratase activity.
The enzyme repairs hydrated NAD(P)H, converting NAD(P)HX back to NAD(P)H while ADP is converted to AMP and phosphate in the dehydration reaction.
GO annotations include NAD(P)HX epimerase activity, ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity, and metabolite repair.
